papers.title: SCALER: Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
papers.what: Splits language-model forecasting into a cheap coarse-shape stage and a fixed-step multi-scale refinement stage, so extra inference compute buys accuracy instead of drift, with average inference roughly 7 times faster than standard test-time-scaling forecasters.
papers.builds_on: Time-LLM (2024, MKICLA63); GPT4TS (2024, 6QQNUTL7); TTT for Abstract Reasoning (2024, W7RPRTCH); ChatTS (2025, VSCNJG5J)

papers.title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting needs Cross Variable Loss
papers.what: Proves point-wise squared error matches the Gaussian likelihood only under spherical residual covariance, then adds CvLoss, a graph penalty over synchronous and lagged residual edges that recovers 84.83 percent of the true cross-variable correlation structure on ECL without changing the backbone.
papers.builds_on: iTransformer (2024, QBX2TI2X); PatchTST (2023, YY67LF3R); Forecast Collapse in TSFMs (2026, 2608.14106)

papers.title: R^3-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
papers.what: Measures how reasoning models divide one shared budget across six competing problems against an oracle built from their own single-problem response curves, finding unrealized headroom in 71 of 72 cells and equal allocation beating the model's own choices for four of six models.
papers.builds_on: Chain-of-Thought (2023, HBLPTRMY); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); SPRINT (2025, BZKDNHD6); LATS (2024, 77ERE7HA)

papers.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form
papers.what: Finds no gate where the workspace account predicts one, localises the transport of a latent variable into readable form to attention inside a mid-depth window at least 17 times above anywhere shallower, and shows the readout is not a calibrated measure of use.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (2017, PHB9VRVM); SHAP (2017, 46WR27KQ); Latent Reasoning Survey (2025, EMXEJYHV)
